limits: Initial five expanded cases use 1a9e791e3; final pill pair and normal scene use 58b795ae6. No image is relabeled as a later runtime.

Screenshot RGB and band attenuation are not calibrated optical transmittance, a blur-kernel measurement or accessibility certification.
